review_notes: I read the whole file and grepped Mathlib for other definitions of periodicity. The grep covered Periodic/Antiperiodic definitions and `∀ x, f (x + c)` patterns. I found no independent Mathlib definition of the same concept, so I report nothing. I did not search for every possible reformulation, such as invariance under an additive action.
